messages:
Sophia: Heads-up — CloudRep just asked if they can convert 4 racks from our Q3 Dedicated commit into a 'burst credit' pool they sell to marketplace buyers. They say delivery window for those racks shifted +6 weeks; partner wants to offer credits to avoid breaking customer expectation. Asking if we can accept swapping reserved racks for credits and how that affects customer allocations and our joint announcement timeline.
Danny: If those 4 racks move out that's ~32 GPUs in our EU pool. Lead time +6w will hit customers on Dedicated and a couple Private pilots. Who are the impacted commits?
Sophia: Quick list below (they gave reservation IDs).
Sophia: ```
R-893214-EU-dedicated
R-893215-EU-dedicated
R-903004-onprem-pilot
R-903005-onprem-pilot
```
Leah: Two of those are tied to sales contracts — one enterprise onboarding (R-893214) has a firm launch date and we promised on-prem racks in Sept. Can't slide that. The pilot ones are flexible.
CloudRep: CloudRep: sorry for the churn — customs reclassification pushed our manufacturing manifest and we can either ship the racks in late Oct or provide equivalent marketplace 'burst credits' to customers that accept delayed hardware. We can also fast-track a partial ship (2 racks) with an expedite fee.
Matt: On our side, bursting with credits vs physical racks changes routing. If we accept credits we need to: update routing policy to move affected customers into hosted or dedicated-ephemeral pools, update KV cache affinity, and ensure model variant fallback works. That’s ~2-3 days of engineering ops work per customer.
Danny: Also burn-in/test time for racks is non-negotiable for the on-prem pilot (R-903004/5). Those can't be credits.
Leah: Sales asks: can we convert only the marketplace-eligible commit (the 2 pilot racks) into credits and hold the enterprise one? If partner can expedite 2 racks, we take expedited 2 and accept credits for the rest.
Sophia: CloudRep, can you confirm if partial split (2 racks ship on expedited timeline, 2 converted to credits) is possible? And does the partner require the press announcement to be delayed until physical verification?
CloudRep: quick check — yes partial split possible with expedite fee. Press note: partner requires we don't use their logo in announcements referencing physical availability until final QA passes for expedited units. Credits-only customers can be announced immediately as a marketplace feature.
AJ-bot: reservation-check: Found overlapping allocations for R-893214 between EU-dedicated and sales-onboarding. Conflict flagged.
Matt: Proposed plan: 1) Lock R-893214 for enterprise — require partner to expedite 2 racks for this and one pilot; 2) Convert both pilot reservations to burst credits and update contracts; 3) Engineering to run a routing patch and QA in staging — deploy window 48h after contract update; 4) Leah to inform customers about partial change with options.
Leah: I'll draft customer outreach now. Short message to customers: "We are making a temporary change to your provisioning due to a supplier manifest delay — options to accept equivalent credits or keep hardware on expedited delivery." Will share copy in #support before sending.
Danny: Logistics note — if expedite accepted, add 72h for customs clearance; vendor needs to confirm airwaybill by EOD.
CloudRep: Confirmed we can provide airwaybill and expedite invoice by EOD. We will not give logo clearance until QA passes for expedited racks.
Sophia: OK — decision: go partial. Leah, send outreach options; Matt/Danny, prep routing + customs check; I'll coordinate press messaging (announce marketplace credits now, defer hardware mention). Follow-ups standups at 10:30. :thumbsup:
